walmart-trips.feature_policy: Deterministic AllSet feature_noise=1 construction: x_i=onehot(y_i,11)+epsilon_i with epsilon_i drawn once from a CPU torch.Generator seeded by 20260807
walmart-trips.forbidden_feature_policy: feature_noise=0 because it deterministically reveals every label

walmart_validation_only_audit.construction: Ignore all cached Walmart feature values; load only labels and incidence structure, then set x=onehot(y,11)+epsilon using the frozen CPU generator.

mlp.architecture: two-layer MLP with ReLU and dropout

walmart_validation_only_audit.selection_prohibition: Do not tune the feature seed, feature noise, or feature dimension. Neither MLP nor Full validation accuracy may select the construction.

fixed_budget_accuracy_evaluation.fixed_self_loops: N fixed implicit singleton self-loops outside K for every method
fixed_budget_accuracy_evaluation.test_access: Test results are evaluated only after the feature construction and model settings are fixed.

statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction over the final reported dataset-budget family
statistics.structural_baselines: Report paired intervals and a separate Holm family; acknowledge the ten-seed discreteness limit if the enlarged family makes rejection unattainable.
